responsibility: Implements the old-solver fulfillment engine that stores pending predicate obligations, repeatedly processes them through selection and projection, tracks stalled inference dependencies, and converts solver outcomes into fulfillment errors or remaining obligations.
same_name_distinction: This `fulfill.rs` is the old-solver fulfillment engine built around `ObligationForest`, `SelectionContext`, and projection processing; it contrasts with `solve/fulfill.rs`, which performs fulfillment through the new solver’s goal-evaluation machinery.
